title: Same canopy, different place: simulation code and data for sun-view geometry effects on vegetation-index LAI retrieval across Australia
description: PROSAIL simulation pipeline, sourced canopy parameter tables, Australian site and continental-grid geometry scenarios (handheld, Sentinel-2, UAV), terrain analysis, multi-angle retrieval experiments and result files supporting the manuscript submitted to Computers and Electronics in Agriculture. Code: Apache-2.0. Data and figures: CC-BY-4.0. The vendored, patched PyProSAIL is LGPL-3.0-or-later.
